value.summary: VMware CX production datastore - low free space (WARNING)

eventTemplate.title: VMware CX datastore low on space (warning): {dims:datastore.name}
eventTemplate.description:
Free space on production CX datastore {dims:datastore.name} (vCenter {dims:dt.entity.vmware:vcenter.name}) is {alert_condition} the warning threshold of {threshold} GB.

These datastores back member-facing CX hosts such as PRODCXFIL01. A full datastore can make every VM/host on it unresponsive. Investigate growth (large VMDKs, snapshots, backups) and reclaim or expand capacity before it reaches the critical threshold.
